entities.summary: Javon Kinlaw is a Trinidadian American professional football defensive tackle for the Washington Commanders of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Jones County Bobcats and South Carolina Gamecocks and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the first round of the 2020 NFL draft. Kinlaw has also played for the New York Jets.
